meta_characteristic: Decentralized finance application: a financial service built on smart contracts on a public blockchain without intermediaries

dimensions.name: Revenue generation
dimensions.definition: Whether the application charges fees to users for the financial service it provides.
dimensions.application_rule: Assign the characteristic based on whether the application itself charges transaction or service fees to its users.

characteristics.name: Application charges fees
characteristics.definition: The application levies fees on users for transactions or services it provides.

characteristics.name: No application fees
characteristics.definition: The application does not levy fees on users for its own services.

dimensions.name: Market orientation
dimensions.definition: Whether the application offers its financial service directly to end users or serves as a component for other applications.
dimensions.application_rule: Assign the characteristic based on whether end users interact with the application directly or only through other applications.

characteristics.name: End-user facing
characteristics.definition: The application is used directly by end users to access the financial service.

characteristics.name: Building block for other applications
characteristics.definition: The application is used mainly as a component integrated into other applications.

dimensions.name: Governance mode
dimensions.definition: How decisions about the application's rules and parameters are made.
dimensions.application_rule: Assign the characteristic based on whether changes to the application are decided through token-based voting by holders.

characteristics.name: Token-based governance
characteristics.definition: Rules and parameters are changed through voting by holders of governance tokens.

characteristics.name: No token-based governance
characteristics.definition: Rules and parameters are not changed through token-based voting.

dimensions.name: Operating entity
dimensions.definition: Whether an identifiable legal entity operates or maintains the application.
dimensions.application_rule: Assign the characteristic based on whether a identifiable legal entity is publicly identified as operating the application.

characteristics.name: Identifiable operating entity
characteristics.definition: A legal entity or organization is identifiable as operating or maintaining the application.

characteristics.name: No identifiable operating entity
characteristics.definition: No legal entity is identifiable as operating or maintaining the application.

dimensions.name: Blockchain deployment
dimensions.definition: Whether the application is deployed on one or several public blockchains.
dimensions.application_rule: Assign the characteristic based on the number of public blockchains on which the application's smart contracts are deployed.

characteristics.name: Single public blockchain
characteristics.definition: The application's smart contracts are deployed on exactly one public blockchain.

characteristics.name: Multiple public blockchains
characteristics.definition: The application's smart contracts are deployed on two or more public blockchains.

dimensions.name: Smart contract architecture
dimensions.definition: Whether the application's financial logic is implemented in one smart contract or in several interacting smart contracts.
dimensions.application_rule: Assign the characteristic based on the number of smart contracts that implement the application's core financial logic.

characteristics.name: Single smart contract
characteristics.definition: The core financial logic is implemented in one smart contract.

characteristics.name: Multiple interacting smart contracts
characteristics.definition: The core financial logic is distributed across several interacting smart contracts.
